jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Design Generation
jobs.description: Investigating applications of data and ML across the Canva product and contributing to the full life cycle of ML/data models including data analysis, data preprocessing, pipeline development, modelling, tuning and productization. Improving the scalability, speed and performance of existing models, working alongside data specialists, software engineers and product owners.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - ML Platform

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Layout AI
jobs.description: Work closely with a cross functional team of Frontend, Backend and ML Engineers to improve understanding of designs and build new Design AI capabilities. Layout AI is essential in fulfilling Canva's mission to empower the world to design by using AI to automate design decisions.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer

Practical knowledge in productionising chatbots or real-time LLM systems, experience in optimising costs for model deployment, and building recommendation systems including search result ranking and custom homepages. Sydney in-person role.

jobs.title: Business Analyst

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer

jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
